message: changeColumn drops and re-adds "users"."age" because its type, length, or array flag changes. Every existing value in the column is lost.
why: TypeORM's changeColumn does not alter a column in place when its type, length, or array flag changes. It drops the column and adds it again ("To avoid data conversion, we just recreate column").
safeAlternative: For a longer varchar or varchar to text, run ALTER TABLE ... ALTER COLUMN ... TYPE with queryRunner.query(). For other changes, expand and contract: add a new column, backfill it, switch the code, and drop the old column in a later release.
